response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, frameworks), and clear leadership through workshops and open-source projects, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, organizational change leadership, or mobile platform expertise — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership via workshops, open-source projects, and mentoring
Broad technical stack across mobile, web, and systems programming with strong testing focus
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership responsibilities
Lacks documented experience leading organizational change or cross-team alignment initiatives
Mobile platform experience is limited to iOS app maintenance, not ecosystem-wide tooling
